Segnala offerta di lavoro Bring more to life. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Leica Microsystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Shape the Future with Us! At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world. Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. Our advanced microscopes and AI-based image analysis solutions enable users to gain profound insights into development and engineering challenges. Here, you will work on meaningful projects alongside passionate colleagues, driving progress and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Commercial Training & Competency Program Manager is responsible for designing, deploying, and governing a global and consistent commercial capability development framework across all Regions. This role partners closely with Regional Commercial Leaders, Business Units (BUs), and DBS leaders to build a robust and scalable learning ecosystem, strengthen sales competencies, and ensure commercial teams perform at their highest potential. This role requires an experienced commercial leader with strong understanding of sales cycles and process in a B2B environment, customer engagement, and commercial excellence practices. The role is both strategic and hands-on, driving global alignment while enabling local execution. This position reports to the Director Global Commercial Operations and will be part of the Global Commercial Operations team. The position will be fully remote in Italy. In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To Develop and lead the global commercial training strategy by establishing a consistent, scalable learning framework, onboarding programs, and blended learning solutions across all regions. Build and govern a global sales competency framework that defines required capabilities, assesses proficiency, identifies gaps, and drives development plans for all commercial roles. Partner with Regional Commercial Leaders, Business Units, and DBS teams to align training priorities, ensure content relevance, and drive accountability for capability development. Establish robust training governance and operational excellence through standardized processes, content management, reporting, compliance oversight, learning platforms, and Train-the-Trainer networks. Measure impact and continuously improve commercial capabilities by tracking training effectiveness, monitoring competency progress, analyzing performance gaps, and providing actionable insights to leadership. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Training & Development, Commercial Management, or comparable experience 7+ years in Sales, Commercial Excellence, Sales Enablement, or Training roles Demonstrated ability to build and manage global programs and projects Excellent facilitation, communication, and influencing skills Strong command of MS Office, and in particular MS Excel and large language model (LLM) based answer engines such as M365 Copilot, ChatGPT, or Claude Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements Ability to travel 20% of time It would be a plus if you also possess experience in: Working knowledge with Learning Management Systems (Cornerstone, Workday Learning) Leica Microsystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. Base salary and level of employment This role is classified under the applicable CCNL Commercio as Quadro, which defines minimum terms, job classification, and baseline progression frameworks. The expected gross annual salary range for this role is €85000 - 131000, determined based on objective criteria such as experience, skills, and role-related competencies. Bonus / Incentive Pay This job is also eligible for bonus / incentive pay. This is the target earnings as 20% of base annual salary, subject to objective eligibility criteria and performance conditions as set out in the applicable scheme terms and conditions. This job is also eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits. Details regarding these benefits will be provided separately. At Leica Microsystems we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Leica Microsystems can provide. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Europe West Pursuit and Commercial Excellence Team Pursuit Strategist – Assistant Director The opportunity The Pursuit Strategist (PS) partners with account teams to support regional strategic, high-value pursuits driven out of the Europe West (EW) Region. They engage at multiple stages during the pursuit process and are responsible for developing a tailored communications strategy to articulate a compelling ‘Why EY’ proposition in all pursuit collateral. The PS is responsible for the tactical management of all pursuit work-streams including the communication campaign, draft value proposition, proposal development, facilitation of pursuit readiness sessions and orals preparation. Additionally, the PS is required to identify, develop, and implement innovative approaches to pursuit management and drive adoption of these across the EW, including the use of AI to support the pursuit process. Your Key Responsibilities Strategic Pursuit and Opportunity Management Partners with account teams to provide a full-service pursuit management model for EW based strategic, high-end opportunities Serves as a facilitator/key contributor in pursuit strategy sessions, manages output and drives actions Contributes to the EW repository of Country , Region, Industry or Service Line client-facing collateral as appropriate Strategic Client, Internal and External Communications Develops strategic messaging and lead conceptualisation of all client-facing pursuit collateral Manages and leads the development of opportunity value propositions Ultimately responsible for quality control of all client-facing materials during the pursuit Acts as the knowledge steward for the pursuit Administration and Reporting Leads post pursuit analysis and review; makes recommendations for process improvement Maintains relationships with other Pursuit and Commercial Excellence (P&CE) teams and key interdependency groups across the organisation Participates in relevant internal and external networks Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities Champions best-practice pursuit management tools and processes Solution-oriented and makes sound decisions quickly, given tight timeframes Demonstrates versatility in a constantly evolving environment with a wide variety of social styles Influences / challenges the account team to optimise the chances of winning Supervision Responsibilities Works with considerable autonomy while often managing the work of others Contributes to the team connectivity within the EW Pursuits community Provides coaching and mentoring to others; may serve as a Counsellor to other PS’ in the EW region Supports the onboarding and training of new hires in the EW region Develops and coaches BD and client servers, through teaming on pursuits and facilitated training Oversees the work of the pursuit support team, including any third-party resources (e.g., Pursuit Coordinator, external translation services, etc.) Other Requirements As the job involves responding to client needs and varying time zones, we would expect flexibility to accommodate these. Hybrid working available depending on local office requirements Frequent travel may be required Skills And Attributes For Success Good understanding of Business Development and Pursuit Management Excellent communications skills (written and verbal) in English is a must. To qualify for the role you must have Pursuit Management experience Experience in developing external marketing communications (necessary for Senior PS / advantageous for entry-level PS) Experience working in a cross-border, multi-cultural environment (necessary for Senior PS / advantageous for entry-level PS) Ideally, you’ll also have Ability to influence without authority, lead and coach others Proven ability to influence and build collaborative relationships with a wide range of stakeholders What We Look For Excellent project management skills Ability to work independently with minimal supervision A strong communicator with a sharp pen What We Offer We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with MyReward you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings, and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build. Apply now. About Legends Global Legends Global is redefining excellence in sport, entertainment and live events. With unrivalled expertise and international reach, we provide end-to-end solutions – from venue development and event programming to revenue strategy and hospitality. We take a 360-degree, data-driven approach across Partnerships, Hospitality, Merchandise and Attractions, working with leading clients to deliver outstanding experiences that resonate worldwide. Our organisation is committed to fostering an inclusive and forward-thinking environment where diversity drives innovation and collaboration. Guided by our values of Align, Scale, Connect, Team and Win... we create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. The Role The Partnership Sales Manager will be an integral member of the Legends Global Partnerships Team, located in Milan, Bergamo and Cantu. Reporting to the Vice President Commercial Europe, the Sales Manager will be responsible for working with active sponsorship property accounts and internal & external stakeholders. In this pivotal position, you'll drive new business opportunities through strategic prospect engagement and build the foundation for lasting client relationships that fuel our growth in the sports and entertainment space. The Responsibilities Drive sponsorship revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and pursuing new partnership opportunities aligned with commercial objectives and long-term business strategy. Build and nurture strategic client relationships, creating meaningful connections with prospective partners and developing a strong pipeline of future commercial opportunities. Lead consultative sales conversations, understanding client challenges and objectives to develop tailored partnership solutions that deliver mutual value. Develop and deliver compelling sales presentations and proposals, including pitch decks, Keynote presentations, fact sheets, and bespoke commercial materials. Leverage Salesforce and sales reporting tools to manage prospect data, track activity, maintain pipeline visibility, and ensure effective follow-up and opportunity management. Partner closely with the VP Commercial, local sales teams, and strategy teams to align commercial priorities, share market intelligence, and maximise business growth opportunities. Utilise market research and data-driven insights to identify trends, refine targeting strategies, evaluate prospects, and enhance sales effectiveness. Represent Legends and its clients across the industry, including venue tours, networking events, stakeholder meetings, on-site activations, and supporting wider global partnership sales initiatives when required. What We're Looking For Proven sponsorship, sales, business development, or client-facing experience within the sports, entertainment, venue, or wider live events industry, with a track record of delivering commercial results. Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills, with the ability to understand client challenges, identify opportunities, and develop creative commercial solutions. Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling abilities, with fluency in both Italian and English and confidence engaging with senior internal and external stakeholders. Highly self-motivated and organised, capable of working independently, managing multiple prospects and projects simultaneously, and delivering against competing priorities. Commercially minded and data-driven, with experience using CRM systems (preferably Salesforce), analysing market insights, and leveraging data to inform sales strategies. Strong technical and professional capabilities, including proficiency in Microsoft Office (particularly Excel and PowerPoint), Adobe products, willingness to travel, and a bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred. What can we offer? 🏖️ 24 Days Annual Leave – Plenty of time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life outside of work. 💰 Competitive Commission Scheme – Be rewarded for the partnerships and revenue you help bring to the business. 🏦 Pension Contribution – Supporting your future and helping you plan for what's ahead. 🌍 International Career Opportunities – Join a global organisation with the chance to work across world-class sports, entertainment, and live event properties. 🤝 Employee Referral Scheme – Great people know great people. Recommend talented individuals and be rewarded when they join the team. 🚀 A High-Performance Environment – Work alongside industry-leading experts, delivering innovative partnerships for some of the most recognised brands, venues, and rights holders in sport and entertainment. These may include verification of identity, proof of address, right to work, employment history, qualifications, and—where relevant to the role—a basic or enhanced DBS check. All checks will be carried out in line with data protection law and we will only request information that is necessary for the role. Inclusive Workplace At Legends Global , we are committed to leading the entertainment industry towards a greener, faster, and more innovative digital future. There’s never been a better time to join our team. We aim to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers, and suppliers. Join us and make a significant impact from day one. We are committed to active inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunities. This commitment begins with our recruitment and selection process. We welcome discussions about flexible working arrangements. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of our recruitment process, please let us know in your application. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible to ensure it is considered. Commercial Manager | Data Centre Project | Milan, Italy If you're a commercial leader who enjoys being at the centre of major project delivery, influencing strategy, managing risk, and building high-performing teams, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for. Kirby Group Engineering is delivering some of Europe's most complex and technically demanding projects across data centres, life sciences, industrial and energy sectors. Due to continued growth in Italy, we are seeking an experienced Commercial Manager to join a flagship data centre project in Milan. This is a senior leadership role with significant influence across pre-construction, project delivery, commercial governance and client engagement. You'll work closely with Operations, Engineering, Planning and Senior Leadership teams to maximise project performance while developing and mentoring a talented commercial team. Why Kirby Group Engineering? For over 60 years, Kirby Group Engineering has built a reputation as one of Europe's leading engineering and construction delivery partners. Today, the business employs thousands of professionals across Ireland, the UK and mainland Europe, delivering some of the world's most advanced data centre, life sciences and industrial projects. You'll be heavily involved from bid evaluation and contract negotiation through to project completion and final account settlement, ensuring commercial objectives are achieved while supporting successful project delivery.
